description: R018 false pass remediation: contract-only relabeling. R018 is NOT a real runtime migration implementation. It is a contract-only Python module that operates on dict-like fake application records with no DB access, no runtime wiring, and no state persistence.
r018_original_claim_summary: R018 was merged as 'schema migration completed' with tests claiming 24/24 PASS. modules/schema_migration/ provides SchemaMigrationRegistry, forward/backward migration paths, dirty-state detection, backup, rollback, idempotency, and history — all operating on in-memory Python dicts.
r018_actual_source_reality: R018 source is a pure-Python contract module (modules/schema_migration/schema_migration.py). The SchemaMigrationRegistry.migrate_forward() accepts dict-like fake application records, computes checksums, manages migration history in memory, and returns MigrationReport — without any DB read/write, file I/O, runtime state persistence, or network calls.
r018_false_pass_note: Historical false-pass: R018 was incorrectly labeled as 'completed' in round_patch_mapping.md and current_round.yaml. This candidate corrects the label to contract-only. Original merged commit and evidence preserved as audit trail.
